summary: Reviewed 12 selected items against 4 reserve candidates and 3 days of recent history. All 12 are concrete, recent (within the 24h window), and well-distributed across news, analysis, and practitioner stories, with no in-set duplicates. OpenAI is at its acknowledged 3-story cap with three genuinely distinct angles (health product, NEJM pediatric study, alignment research). Keeping all items, no replacements needed. Two advisory flags: the selected GLM-5.2 benchmark and the unselected GLM-5.2 local-run reserve cover the same model from distinct angles, and two items (Altman and Amodei remarks) are third-party paraphrases rather than primary sources, so they are traceable to named events but not directly sourced.
